about: Session 1032 (chain 071): five figures of the All grids tab of /cost-of-power, each with the check key the page writes and the value production showed on 23 October 2026 at about 06:30 UTC (the page column of warehouse/replication/siting.py's run, runs/repl1020.out), and how the Python package computes it from the warehouse's tables. The tab reads its own files (site/data/siting/, site/data/datacenter/); the package reads the tables those files were built from.

figures.what: HB_HUBAVG's twelve-month day-ahead price, October 2025 to September 2026 in Central standard time (UTC-6): the mean of the hours held. An hour is the first table's that holds it: ercot_all_hub_prices_history, then iso_dam_hub_prices (the order of warehouse/derived/datacenter_page.py's TABLES).

The node's basis spread: the 90th percentile of its daily day-ahead basis to HB_HUBAVG less the 10th (pandas' linear quantile), each rounded to four decimals as the tab's file writes them, over the node file's twelve months (nodes.json's pct_from to pct_to).
The node's intraday swing: the mean of its daily dam_spread_4h (each day's four dearest day-ahead hours' mean less its four cheapest), rounded to four decimals, over the same twelve months.
NYISO's New York City zone's demand growth: the mean hourly demand of EIA-930 sub-region NYIS:ZONJ in 2025 over 2024, less one, in percent, rounded to four decimals.

not_reproduced.why: The second card's HB_HUBAVG all-in: the day-ahead energy above (the first figure) plus ERCOT's four-peak transmission charge, whose rate is texas_delivery_charges's postage stamp rate. That table is internal (the record holds it), so the package refuses it on the live set and Redivis and warns on a local file; the charge's part cannot be reproduced from a public table.
